messages:
anita: kicking off rolling deploy to prod at 11:05 PST (window 11:05-11:35). please watch inference SLOs (p95 latency, error-rate, token cost). I'll pin the canary group to v3.2.1-firstpass. :rocket:

deploy-bot: [deploy started] rolling canary group 1 -> v3.2.1-firstpass. health checks: 0/6 failed so far.

drew: watching p95 on /generate — seeing a small hop in p95 from ~180ms -> ~410ms on a canary node. digging. :eyes:

suzanne: can we pin routing to a cpu-fallback if p95 > 400ms for >2m? add a fallback policy in the rollout config.

samir: +1. we should avoid noisy error-rate alerts during the spike; suggest temporarily mute the non-paged alert channel for the canary group but keep paged thresholds intact.

infra-oncall: muting non-paged signals for canary now: `alertctl mute inference-error-rate --scope=canary --duration=15m` — done :white_check_mark:

drew: root cause looks like a KV cache miss storm when quantized weights are loading. increasing cache prewarm on canary nodes. patch pushed to k8s: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  kv_preload: "true"
```

deploy-bot: health checks: 1 warning, 0 failed. canary progress: 20%.

suzanne: if p95 doesn't drop under 300ms in the next 3m we stop rollout and pin back to v3.2.0. sound good? :thinking:

anita: agreed. @samir, be ready for rollback steps.

samir: on it. rollback playbook preflight: - notify #eng-oncall - pin routing to v3.2.0 via `route.pin=3.2.0` - run `redwood rollout cancel --canary` if needed

drew: p95 trending back down to ~240ms after prewarm. keeping an eye on error bursts.

deploy-bot: canary finished: progress 100%. no failed health checks. rollforward complete. :tada:

anita: nice work — please add a quick note in release notes about the KV prewarm change and the fallback policy we used.

suzanne: adding to release notes: "added kv_preload config and temporary canary routing fallback; monitoring thresholds adjusted for rollout."

infra-oncall: unmuted non-paged alerts. :white_check_mark:

samir: closing the loop — no paged incidents. marking deploy as successful.

anita: thanks everyone. moving to post-deploy watch for 30m.
